preamble: In Palauan, Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *z regularly appears as r, the alveolar flap [ɾ]. PMP *z is reconstructed by Blust as the voiced postalveolar affricate /dʒ/ (a voiced palatal affricate); some treatments write it /ɟ͡ʝ/. Palauan lost both the friction and the palatal place of the affricate, leaving a coronal flap. Nearby Chamorro instead devoiced *z to ch [ts].

examples.to: rayl 'road, path, way; connection between families'
examples.note: Chamorro chalan 'road' shows the ch [ts] reflex of the same etymon.

examples.to: or-rayl 'lead (an animal); drive (a boat, car); start (an engine)'
examples.note: Causative of the same root as rayl.

sources: Blust, R. & Trussel, S. (2020). Austronesian Comparative Dictionary: Sets z. https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_z.htm
